svg.text: Fused Transition backward, one launch: 132 CTAs in two roles (D = 128, H = 512, bf16)
Saved by the forward: x, xn, dy, rstd, c1 = mean·rstd, gamma, W_a, W_b, W_s — nothing else is read, nothing intermediate is written.
Weight CTAs — 64 of them (8 hidden slices × 8 replicas)
own a 64-unit hidden slice; its W_s / W_a / W_b stay resident (48 KB)
stage 1 — each warpgroup, its own 64 rows of a 128-row tile
dh = dy·W_s · [a|b] = xn·[W_a;W_b]^T (one m64n128 chain)
gate → h, dA, dB → shared memory (stmatrix)
stage 2 — over all 128 rows, split between the warpgroups
WG0: dW_a += dA^T·xn , dW_s^T[:, 0:64] += h^T·dy
WG1: dW_b , dW_s^T[:, 64:128] — 96 fp32 accumulators/thread
recomputes dh, a, b for its slice: the only redundant work (1.375× FLOP),
bought in exchange for zero cross-CTA communication
→ partials [64 CTAs][3][64 hs][128 d] fp32
Input CTAs — 68 of them
stream all eight 64-unit hidden chunks of a 128-row tile (2-slot TMA ring)
per chunk j
dh_j = dy·W_s,j · [a|b]_j = xn·[W_a;W_b]_j^T
gate → dA_j, dB_j as bf16 in the wgmma A-fragment registers
(the m64n64 C fragment IS the m64k64 A fragment: no smem round trip)
d_xn += [dA|dB]_j · [W_a;W_b]_j (RS m64n128, accumulates in registers)
epilogue, same fragment layout — d_xn never leaves registers
xhat = (x − mean)·rstd , wdy = gamma·d_xn , row sums over the quad
dx = bf16(bf16((wdy − xhat·ca − cb)·rstd) + dy) · dgamma, dbeta partials
→ dx (global) , partials [68 CTAs][8 warps][2][128] fp32 — one row per warp, no atomic
reduce_partials — one small launch
sums both partial sets → dW_a, dW_b, dW_s (bf16, rounded once) and dgamma, dbeta (fp32). Total: 406 µs at L384 against 821 µs for the five-launch path.
